context_requirements: Active AMPK signaling and dependence on AMPK for metabolic homeostasis
Expression of the drug's off-target kinases (e.g., BMPR/ACVR1, KDR/FLT1, LCK, RSK/MKNK1) for AMPK-independent effects
Intact p53 pathway for maximal apoptosis and G2/M arrest
High metabolic/lipid synthesis flux (e.g., androgen-dependent prostate cancer) for strong anti-proliferative response
falsifiers: No change in HMGCR, HMGCS1, INSIG1, or other SREBP/lipid synthesis genes at 6 or 24 h
No induction of DDIT4, TRIB3, CHAC1, or other ATF4/ISR targets
No G2/M arrest or apoptosis signature at 24 h
No difference in response between p53-wildtype and p53-mutant lines
No anti-proliferative transcriptional signature in VCAP or other prostate lines

evidence.supports: Compound C inhibits AMPK but has AMPK-independent antiproliferative and cytotoxic effects in glioma cells
Compound C suppresses colorectal cancer cell proliferation via G2/M arrest, apoptosis, and autophagy
BAY-3827 is a potent AMPK inhibitor with anti-proliferative effects in androgen-dependent prostate cancer and affects HMGCR/FASN lipid metabolism genes
BML-275/compound C induces ROS, DNA damage signaling, G2/M arrest, and apoptosis in pancreatic cancer cells
Compound C induces p53-dependent apoptosis and G2/M arrest in skin cancer cells via ROS/DNA damage
